message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling (both under her own name and her pseudonym Robert Galbraith):

| Title | Year | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| **Harry Potter series** | 1997‑2007 | 7 books: *Philosopher’s Stone* (UK)/*Sorcerer’s Stone* (US), *Chamber of Secrets*, *Prisoner of Azkaban*, *Goblet of Fire*, *Order of the Phoenix*, *Half‑Blood Prince*, *Deathly Hallows*.  The series is a global phenomenon, selling over 500 million copies worldwide. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel published under her own name.  A dark, satirical look at small‑town politics. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable released as a free online book and later in print; it was written in response to the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| **The Tales of Beedle the Bard** | 2008 | A collection of wizarding fairy tales that appears in *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows*.  It was published as a standalone book for fans. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 | A fictional textbook that became the basis for the *Fantastic Beasts* film series. |
| **Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald** (book) | 2018 | Companion novel to the second film in the *Fantastic Beasts* franchise. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | First book in the Cormoran Strike detective series.  It was adapted into the TV series *Strike* (2020). |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ink Black** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2022 | Fifth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles cover Rowling’s most widely read and commercially successful works across fantasy, mystery, and contemporary fiction.
